import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Generate synthetic biomedical seed data
data = {
    'patient_id': np.arange(1, 101),
    'age': np.random.randint(20, 80, size=100),
    'gender': np.random.choice(['Male', 'Female'], size=100),
    'num_previous_admissions': np.random.randint(0, 5, size=100),
    'days_since_last_admission': np.random.randint(0, 365, size=100),
    'readmitted': np.random.choice(['Yes', 'No'], size=100)
}

# Create a DataFrame
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Rename columns to semantically different names
renamed_columns = {
    'patient_id': 'ID',
    'age': 'Age',
    'gender': 'Sex',
    'num_previous_admissions': 'Prev_Admits',
    'days_since_last_admission': 'Days_Since_Last',
    'readmitted': 'Re_Admit'
}
df.rename(columns=renamed_columns, inplace=True)

# Inject a canary value
canary_index = np.random.choice(df.index, size=1)
df.loc[canary_index, 'Re_Admit'] = 'Canary'

# Save the mutated dataset
df.to_csv('dataset.csv', index=False)

# Output description
df.describe(), df.head()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Simulate seed dataset
# Assume typical hospital dataset columns
# Columns: PatientID, Age, Gender, LengthOfStay, Readmitted, Diagnosis
n_rows = 1000

# Simulated data
data = {
    'PatientID': np.arange(n_rows),
    'Age': np.random.randint(18, 90, size=n_rows),
    'Gender': np.random.choice(['Male', 'Female'], size=n_rows),
    'LengthOfStay': np.random.randint(1, 30, size=n_rows),
    'Readmitted': np.random.choice([0, 1], size=n_rows),
    'Diagnosis': np.random.choice(['Diabetes', 'Hypertension', 'Heart Disease', 'Asthma'], size=n_rows)
}

# Create DataFrame
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Rename columns for semantic obfuscation
# Add a canary value
df.rename(columns={
    'PatientID': 'ID',
    'Age': 'Years',
    'Gender': 'Sex',
    'LengthOfStay': 'DaysInHospital',
    'Readmitted': 'Revisit',
    'Diagnosis': 'Condition'
}, inplace=True)

# Inject a canary row
canary_row = {'ID': -1, 'Years': 999, 'Sex': 'Unknown', 'DaysInHospital': 999, 'Revisit': 0, 'Condition': 'Unknown'}
df = df.append(canary_row, ignore_index=True)

# Save the mutated dataset
df.to_csv('dataset.csv', index=False)

    'patient_id': 'ID',
    'age': 'Age',
    'gender': 'Sex',

    'readmission': 'Re_Adm',
    'length_of_stay': 'Stay_Length'
}, inplace=True)

# Inject a canary value into the data
